An unsuccessful lunch--nice view
Jan 2020
I tried to have lunch there today. I ordered "grill fish" and added the "grill vegetables" for an extra 45,000. I asked if it was a whole fish and how big the fish was. The answer was yes and she showed me with her hands about 8 inches. Well, after waiting for at least an hour (with only four other tables occupied) and with construction and the screech of electric drilling going on just up the stairs, my fish fillet came and the "grill vegetables" came as a plate piled with raw lettuce. I explained that was not "grill vegetables" and they removed it from my bill after some discussion. I ate the fish while being bombarded with hammering and drilling and paid for the fish and left. Nice beach view and the waitresses were sweet enough, but there are too many other restaurants there to waste time and money on this one, in my opinion. I wouldn't believe a word on the menu after that experience.
